reason: Systematic review of early keratoconus diagnostics (107 studies); CXL appears only as the reason early detection matters.
PROSPERO-registered systematic review with random-effects meta-analysis of CXL in corneas <400 um; 29 records/470 eyes pooled, RCTs eligible but number not stated.
Five databases systematically searched and 12 studies meta-analysed comparing laser refractive surgery with vs without prophylactic CXL.
PRISMA systematic review of 35 articles (2,186 eyes) on standard and accelerated CXL in patients under 18; descriptive comparison only, no pooling.
Tagged Systematic Review but the abstract is a narrative overview of keratoconus and quality of life with no search, criteria or study count; CXL is one treatment among many.
Systematic search of three databases and Hedges' g random-effects meta-analysis of retinal/choroidal OCT changes after CXL; 10 studies, 233 eyes.
Systematic search 2014-2024 and meta-analysis of 28 studies (1,764 eyes) comparing epi-on and epi-off CXL, with RCT vs non-RCT subgroups but no RCT count given.

Systematic review with random-effects meta-analysis and meta-regression of corneal biomechanical change after CXL; 12 studies from 8,139 records; topic is a biomechanical outcome rather than a protocol comparison.
Systematic review and meta-analysis of 15 studies (1,647 eyes) comparing LASIK with LASIK plus accelerated CXL (LASIK Xtra).

Systematic review and meta-analysis of 7 observational studies of ICL implantation after CXL; the pooled intervention is the ICL and CXL defines the population, so whether this is a synthesis 'of CXL' is a judgment call.
PRISMA systematic review and meta-analysis restricted to RCTs of epi-on vs epi-off CXL; 13 RCTs, 872 patients, 1,041 eyes.
PRISMA systematic review of optical coherence elastography in the anterior segment (25 studies); CXL is mentioned only as an example of treatment effects OCE can measure.
Umbrella review of 5 systematic reviews/meta-analyses of CXL for infectious keratitis; no statistical pooling possible.
PROSPERO-registered systematic review and meta-analysis of customised PRK plus CXL vs CXL alone; 8 nonrandomised studies, abstract states no RCTs were retrieved.
Largely narrative review of topical losartan for corneal haze that claims a systematic review of in-human losartan studies; CXL is named only as one cause of haze.
Five databases searched for RCTs and 14 RCTs meta-analysed comparing accelerated with conventional CXL.
PRISMA systematic review of pulsed vs continuous CXL with 29 included papers, 14 in a random-effects meta-analysis; topic is pulsed UV delivery rather than accelerated vs standard.
Systematic review of Brillouin microscopy for corneal diagnostics (16 articles); CXL is not the subject.

Tagged systematic review with network meta-analysis of combined refractive treatments for keratoconus (ICRS, phakic IOL, surface ablation, CXL); CXL is one component in the compared combinations and the abstract gives no search detail or study count.
PRISMA systematic review and meta-analysis of CXL for ectasia after refractive laser surgery; 15 studies, 512 eyes.
Systematic review and meta-analysis of 13 studies comparing CXL alone with CXL plus refractive laser ablation in progressive keratoconus.
Systematic search and meta-analysis of 28 studies (2,820 eyes) comparing SMILE/LASIK/PRK with and without prophylactic CXL.
Self-described systematic review of scleral (not corneal) collagen cross-linking for progressive myopia; methods are described only loosely and the intervention is outside corneal CXL.
Updated meta-analysis with four-database search of RCTs of adjuvant PACK-CXL vs standard antimicrobial therapy; 7 RCTs, 283 patients, Cochrane RoB and GRADE applied.
Five-database systematic review with weighted-mean-difference meta-analysis of epi-on vs epi-off CXL; 27 studies, 1,622 eyes.
Systematic review and RevMan meta-analysis of 48 RCTs covering CXL vs control and comparisons between CXL protocols at short and long term.
Systematic review and meta-analysis of 23 studies of phakic IOLs in keratoconus alone or combined with CXL and/or ICRS; CXL is a combination subgroup rather than the primary intervention.
Systematic review of 11 articles (RCTs, observational studies and case series) on CXL for bullous keratopathy; outcomes summarised without meta-analysis.
PubMed/EMBASE/CENTRAL search and network meta-analysis of 8 RCTs comparing accelerated CXL protocols (30 mW 3 min, 18 mW 5 min, 9 mW 10 min) for progressive keratoconus.
Self-described 'systemic literature review' of 97 studies on CXL beyond keratoconus; search methods are not described in the abstract.
PRISMA systematic review and random-effects meta-analysis of 4 studies (329 eyes) comparing 18 mW/5 min with 9 mW/10 min accelerated CXL.
Five-database systematic review (6 studies) with meta-analysis (5 studies) of supplemental oxygen during epi-on CXL for keratoconus.
Systematic search of four sources and weighted-mean-difference meta-analysis of 11 studies (888 eyes) comparing standard, accelerated and transepithelial CXL in pediatric keratoconus.
PRISMA systematic review of machine-learning detection of subclinical keratoconus (26 papers); CXL is background only.
MEDLINE/EMBASE search for RCTs and NRSIs comparing epi-on vs epi-off CXL; 15 studies (9 RCTs, 6 NRSIs) included, 4 low-risk-of-bias studies pooled.
Systematic review of 37 studies (2,078 eyes) with pooled analysis of post-CXL progression rate in children (pooled 9.9%, I2 86%), i.e. a proportion meta-analysis.
PubMed/Cochrane systematic review (26 studies) and meta-analysis (21 studies) of standard, transepithelial and accelerated CXL in patients 18 or younger.
AJO summary of the Cochrane systematic review of transepithelial vs epi-off CXL; 13 RCTs, 661 eyes, Kmax meta-analysis of 5 RCTs; note this is a companion publication of PMID 33765359.
Systematic review of 143 papers on alternative indications for CXL (infectious keratitis, bullous keratopathy, PMD, post-LASIK ectasia, refractive use); no pooling.

PROSPERO-registered systematic review and meta-analysis of UV light for superficial infections; 34 of 42 clinical studies were UVA-CXL for microbial keratitis and pooled analyses are of UVA-CXL, but the review scope is UV therapy generally (11 RCTs, 7 non-RCTs, 24 case studies, 11 in vitro).
Systematic review of 26 publications on infectious keratitis after epi-off CXL; descriptive synthesis of pathogens, timing and risk factors.
Cochrane systematic review and meta-analysis of transepithelial vs epi-off CXL for progressive keratoconus; 13 RCTs, 723 eyes.

Meta-analysis of iontophoresis-assisted vs Dresden CXL in 10 comparative studies (3 RCTs, 586 eyes) with publication-bias and meta-regression analyses; studies 'identified from databases' but the search is not detailed, so SR-MA vs MA-ONLY is uncertain (counts either way).

Systematic review of 14 RCTs comparing CXL protocols (conventional vs transepithelial, accelerated, iontophoresis, riboflavin formulations) with CASPe quality appraisal; no meta-analysis, several protocol comparisons so topic coded OTHER.
PRISMA meta-analysis with PubMed/EMBASE/CENTRAL search of 16 studies (690 eyes) comparing standard and transepithelial CXL.
Systematic review of 16 databases, meta-analysis and trial sequential analysis of 12 RCTs (966 eyes) of transepithelial vs epi-off CXL for corneal ectasia.
Systematic review of 28 studies (1,300 eyes) of conventional, accelerated and transepithelial CXL in pediatric keratoconus with RevMan pooled analysis.
Cochrane systematic review of PACK-CXL for bacterial keratitis; 3 trials (2 RCTs, 1 quasi-RCT, 59 eyes) with pooled risk ratios.
JBI protocol for a systematic review of adjuvant PACK-CXL vs standard antimicrobial treatment; no results.
Systematic review of 46 studies on adjuvant PACK-CXL for infectious keratitis with meta-analysis of the 4 included RCTs.
Meta-analysis of 6 RCTs of accelerated vs standard CXL using a comprehensive Cochrane-methodology search and two-author data extraction.
Systematic review of the literature with meta-analysis of 7 studies (283 eyes) comparing accelerated and conventional CXL.

Systematic review of 23 papers comparing standard and accelerated epi-off CXL at one year; the 'sub-group analysis' is an ANOVA across study means rather than a formal meta-analysis, so SR rather than SR-MA.
Systematic review and meta-analysis of 95 case series of ICRS procedures in keratoconus, including ICRS+CXL (20 studies) and ICRS+CXL+PRK (9 studies) subgroups; CXL is one of the compared add-ons.
BMJ Open protocol for the systematic review and meta-analysis of transepithelial vs epi-off CXL (later published as PMID 33383093); no results.
Single case report of Colletotrichum dematium keratitis with a literature review of 13 prior cases; CXL is an incidental adjunct in the case, not the subject.
Protocol for a systematic review, meta-analysis and trial sequential analysis of accelerated vs conventional CXL RCTs; no results.
Systematic review (41 studies) and meta-analysis (23 studies) of the natural history of untreated keratoconus; CXL is referred to only when discussing treatment thresholds.

Systematic review of 18 studies of intrastromal corneal rings in adult keratoconus; the aim is ICRS alone, but a result compares ICRS+CXL with ICRS alone, so CXL is at most a secondary comparator and the author may prefer N.
MEDLINE literature review tagged as systematic, grouping 21 studies into sequential CXL, simultaneous CXL and no-CXL excimer surface ablation; single-database search with descriptive synthesis.
PRISMA systematic review of 17 articles on the sequence of combined ICRS and CXL, with meta-analysis of the 6 studies with 12-month data.
PubMed/Embase/Cochrane/trial-registry search and meta-analysis of 11 trials comparing standard with accelerated epi-off CXL.
Six-source literature search and weighted-mean-difference meta-analysis of 22 studies (1,158 eyes) comparing conventional Dresden and accelerated CXL.
Multi-database (including Chinese databases) systematic review and meta-analysis of 8 studies (455 eyes) of epi-off vs transepithelial CXL.
MEDLINE/EMBASE/CENTRAL search for RCTs and meta-analysis of 6 RCTs (7 reports, 344 eyes) comparing conventional with transepithelial CXL.
PubMed/Cochrane/Embase systematic search and RevMan meta-analysis of 3 RCTs (244 eyes) of transepithelial vs standard CXL.

Four-database systematic review and meta-analysis of 24 comparative studies of modified CXL (accelerated or transepithelial) vs standard CXL; topic coded OTHER because it pools both the ACCEL and EPION comparisons.
Systematic search of PubMed, Embase and Web of Science with Stata meta-analysis of 7 studies (140 eyes) of CXL for post-laser-vision-correction ectasia.
Systematic review of 5 RCTs (289 eyes) of CXL vs no treatment at one year with pooling of BSCVA, thickness and cylinder; pooling withheld for Kmax, UCVA and SE because of heterogeneity.
MEDLINE/Cochrane systematic review of 13 papers (490 eyes) on CXL in patients 18 or younger, 9 papers meta-analysed with standardised mean differences.
Systematic review of 241 articles on all non-graft keratoconus management options over 20 years (contact lenses, ICRS, phakic IOL, CXL); CXL is one of several modalities surveyed.
Described as a systematic review of 21 articles (145 eyes) on PACK-CXL protocols by pathogen; eyes are pooled descriptively but no search strategy or formal meta-analysis is reported.

Systematic literature review (PubMed, Web of Science) and random/fixed-effects meta-analysis of visual, topographic and structural outcomes after CXL for keratoconus; study count not given in the abstract.
Systematic review of 25 studies (2 RCTs, 13 case series, 10 case reports; 210 eyes) of CXL for infectious keratitis with summary proportions healed.
Literature search for RCTs of CXL vs control in keratoconus with weighted-mean-difference meta-analysis; RCT count not stated in the abstract.
Cochrane systematic review of CXL vs no treatment for keratoconus; 3 RCTs (219 eyes analysed) and the abstract states data could not be pooled, so SR without meta-analysis.
Medline systematic review of reported cases of infectious keratitis after CXL; 19 articles screened, 10 included (10 eyes).
PubMed/EMBASE/Cochrane search with Cochrane methodology and meta-analysis of CXL for progressive keratoconus (1,171 participants, 1,557 eyes); study count not stated in the abstract.
Systematic review and meta-analyses of epi-off CXL for keratoconus and secondary ectasia; 49 studies including 4 unique RCTs (8 papers), 29 prospective and 12 retrospective.
Titled a systematic review but the abstract describes a current overview of CXL principles, protocols and indications with no search, criteria or study count.
Systematic review of 12 articles (104 eyes) on CXL for infectious keratitis with pooled analysis of the proportion with melting arrested (85%).
EMBASE/MEDLINE systematic review of CXL for nonectatic disorders (corneal oedema, infectious keratitis) 1970-2011; descriptive synthesis, no study count given.
Primary genetic association study of LOX variants in keratoconus; the 'meta P values' combine the authors' own case-control and family samples, and CXL is background only.
Tagged systematic review on corneal elasticity, diabetes and IOP; concerns glucose-mediated collagen cross-linking, not riboflavin/UVA CXL.
